cover: RAG or fine-tuning? A decision table

slides.title: Do the documents change?
slides.body: Use retrieval. Update the index and the next answer uses the new version. A tuned model keeps the old one until retrained.

slides.title: Do people need to see the source?
slides.body: Use retrieval. Each answer can cite the passage it came from, so someone can check it.

slides.title: Do access rights differ by person?
slides.body: Use retrieval, with permissions checked at search time. A tuned model can repeat its training data to anyone.

slides.title: Right facts, wrong shape or style?
slides.body: Fine-tuning may help, if it happens across thousands of requests and a careful prompt still falls short.

slides.title: No agreed examples of good output?
slides.body: Hold off on tuning. Without hundreds of examples people agree on, training has nothing to learn from.

slides.title: Current facts in a fixed format?
slides.body: Use both: a tuned model for the format, and retrieval for the facts at question time.
